purpose: Define the deterministic renderer-neutral handoff from an accepted/editable CAS semantic appearance state into CAPP validation, asset resolution, coverage diagnostics and render-plan production without making MCCS, PAPT or raster output authoritative character truth.

parameter_value_shape.ordinal_step: integer within declared scale when value_kind is ordinal5/ordinal7
parameter_value_shape.ref_id: stable governed ref for enum/profile/palette values
parameter_value_shape.ref_ids: ordered stable governed refs for layer-set values
parameter_value_shape.authority_mode: copied from parameter registry for validation, not user-supplied authority

feature_instance_shape.parameter_values: CAS feature-field values limited by feature template

deterministic_sort: feature parameter values by field ID
presentation wardrobe refs lexically unless explicit layer order metadata owns ordering
actual-equipment projection refs by owning equipment projection order
normalization.unknown_parameter_behavior: migration_or_import_review_required; never silently drop or reinterpret
normalization.canonical_semantic_hash: SHA-256 of normalized renderer-neutral appearance state before renderer/asset/view inputs

validation_order: apply permission filtering before asset selection or diagnostics
validate parameter IDs, value kinds and ordinal bounds
validate Species/Form/CAPP eligibility and required/read-only constraints
normalize semantic state and compute semantic appearance hash
resolve parameter values to renderer strategies
classify per-parameter and aggregate renderer coverage
derive requested view/output only after semantic render plan is stable

resolver_classes.name: component_family_select
resolver_classes.use: Discrete family/profile chooses one reusable component family.

resolver_classes.name: discrete_variant_select
resolver_classes.use: Ordinal or enum selects an authored/procedurally-approved discrete variant; no continuous raster warp.

resolver_classes.name: integer_anchor_composition
resolver_classes.use: Authorized component anchors shift/recompose by integer logical pixels within topology/fit constraints.

resolver_classes.name: palette_zone_map
resolver_classes.use: Semantic palette-zone choice maps through controlled palette ramps without duplicating base raster geometry.

resolver_classes.name: mask_pattern_overlay
resolver_classes.use: Pattern/marking/cosmetic state resolves to topology-compatible masks or controlled deterministic overlays.

resolver_classes.name: layer_or_profile_reference
resolver_classes.use: Parameter resolves to an ordered governed layer set or presentation profile.

resolver_classes.name: read_only_owner_projection
resolver_classes.use: Visual state is projected from another owner domain and cannot be mutated by CAS.

resolver_classes.name: semantic_only_or_derived
resolver_classes.use: State remains semantic or derives other values and may not require a unique raster component.

allowed_render_operations: select discrete authored or approved deterministic variant
forbidden_render_operations: arbitrary rotation to fake missing view coverage
silent nearest-value coercion when an exact semantic value lacks coverage
generative image synthesis as required core rendering

parameter_resolution_receipt.rule: Every active parameter receives an explicit resolution receipt for the requested topology/view. A parameter may be semantically valid while renderer coverage is partial/unsupported.

coverage_and_fallback.missing_asset_behavior: parameter/feature receipt becomes partial/unsupported/unknown with explicit demand diagnostic; semantic appearance is not rewritten
coverage_and_fallback.smaller_view_behavior: CAS-SD1 detail-priority grammar may intentionally omit lower-priority detail; omission is a declared view projection loss, not semantic deletion
coverage_and_fallback.optional_user_action: User may explicitly choose a supported alternative, which creates a normal CAS draft change.

mccs_adapter.rule: MCCS carries CAS draft/workspace operations; CAS-PARAM-1 remains the semantic parameter vocabulary and CAPP remains appearance authority.
mccs_adapter.ordinal5_numeric_adapter: MCCS numeric convenience value = ordinal_step / 2; CAS ordinal step remains authoritative.
mccs_adapter.ordinal7_numeric_adapter: MCCS numeric convenience value = ordinal_step / 3; CAS ordinal step remains authoritative.
mccs_adapter.body_binding: MCCS-03 morphology/silhouette can carry CAS body parameters directly through stable IDs.
mccs_adapter.structural_feature_binding: MCCS-03/MCCS-05 carry eligible appendage/head feature structures and anchors.
mccs_adapter.head_scalar_gap: Current MCCS-05 needs a bounded parameter/value transport or adapter for detailed CAS head/face scalars. Do not encode them as opaque filenames or invent a second CAS engine.
mccs_adapter.wardrobe_binding: MCCS-09 carries wardrobe/equipment presentation composition and fit references.
mccs_adapter.derivative_binding: MCCS-13 carries requested CAS-SD1 output profiles and declared projection losses.

emitted_when: support_state is unknown due to missing production coverage
anti_explosion_rules: Demand reusable component families/variants, not complete baked character combinations.
Palette-only differences prefer palette-zone maps rather than duplicate geometry rasters.
Pattern/marking differences prefer masks/controlled overlays where style permits.
Independent compatible components remain composable; do not enumerate their full cross-product.
A dependent parameter cluster may request a bounded variant matrix only when independent composition cannot preserve CAS-SD1 quality.
Every produced asset remains manifested with provenance, topology/view coverage and CAS-SD1 native density.

import_rule: Reference-image/photo/sketch matching ends before this handoff. Once a user accepts or edits the proposal, the resulting state is ordinary CAS-PARAM-1 semantic state and follows the identical compile path.
next_design_outputs: MCCS-05 bounded CAS parameter transport contract
PAPT parameter-driven asset demand and coverage ledger
golden CAS/CAPP/PAPT reference profiles across easy and difficult topologies
